title: Phosphor Vine (磷光藤蔓)
body:
A black vine with cyan-glowing leaf veins at night (#7DA9B8, lightest tone). The natural warning sign of dream anomalies.

## Rules
- NOT neon — extremely subtle
- Cyan glow appears only at night
- Dreamcatchers track nightmare events by following phosphor-vine clusters

## Appears at
- Tajanda Manor (courtyard walls)
- Coastal Hospital (north wall, densest)
- Antique Shop (glass-case display)

title: Magic System
body:
Five Fundamental Orders of Mechanized Rune Magic, taught institutionally at the Miroir Institute.

## The Five Orders
- Copper / Resonance
- Iron-magnetic / Binding
- Salt / Disruption
- Glass / Revelation
- Mirror / Reflection

title: Religion — The Aequorian Order
body:
澂教 / The Aequorian Order — the faith of New Miri. Not worship of a powerful god; veneration of "the reliable return of the tide." Secular, stable, reassuring — like a well-run public institution.

## Terminology
- Faith: 澂教 / Aequorian Order
- Building: 澂堂 / the Aequorium
- Adherents: 澂徒 / Aequorians
- Clergy: 澂守 / Wardens (secular administrators, not priests)

## Naming
- Aequor (Latin: "calm sea surface"); 澂 (chéng, archaic form of 澄) = "water still and clear"

## Symbol
- Abstract geometric tide-mark: horizontal line + calm arc above it + rhythmic tick marks (like a tide table)
- Gilt on white walls. NO real-world religious symbols

## Hidden irony
- The faith venerates "reliable return." Arthur Crowe literally vanishes and returns across generations — Aequorians can't recognize the very thing they worship

title: Core Concept & References
body:
## Core concept
- Players are nightmare-hunting content creators who drive a van, complete missions, and grow a social-media following

## Genre references
- Phasmophobia — investigation mechanics
- XCOM — strategic time pressure
- Monster Hunter — quest structure
- Dave the Diver — social-media progression

## Visual identity
- Chinese fantasy (玄幻 / 修仙 — "magic taught in schools") + dieselpunk mechanical equipment + vintage camera aesthetics
- Art style: Sifu + Disco Elysium + Dishonored 2 — simple hard-brush impasto
- Engine: Unity 6 with URP; custom post-processing for a Chinese gongbi (工笔画) filter

title: Missions & Time System
body:
## Mission types
- Identify & Find — locate the nightmare
- Capture — trap / contain it
- Banish — eliminate it

## Time / turn system
- 8:1 compression on the map screen
- Half-day turns: morning / evening
- Quest types: Assignments vs. Hot Topics

title: Camera Equipment
body:
## Camera schema
- Primary (handheld): photo / reveal
- Secondary (hold): High Power Flash charge
- Tripod attachment: behavior TBD (open design question)

## Open question
- Reveal-effect persistence: persistent vs. time-limited — unresolved

- Italianate villa (2 floors + attic + central belvedere tower) in a City North old neighborhood

- Belvedere tower top: lightning rod replaced with a blackened peach-wood sword (桃木剑) — visible as a dusk silhouette
- Door lintel: cinnabar bagua symbol overlaid on an Italianate arch relief
- Arthur's modifications: gas lamps rewired with Edison bulbs; hemp rope on the gate instead of a lock

title: Design Principles & Conventions
body: Conventions for writing briefs, building the world, the document pipeline, and working style.

title: Character Brief Writing Rules
body:
## Rules
- Spec-style design instructions only — not literary prose (少废话，多重点)
- Every sentence is a direct design instruction
- No explanatory parentheses, no self-annotation, no justification of choices
- Replace dramatic metaphors with factual material descriptions (e.g., concrete rust = 钢筋锈水褐红条纹, not poetic language)
- Fully fictionalize real cultural / religious traditions — use only formal / material descriptions to avoid offensive appropriation
- Web-sourced reference images are internal / moodboard use only — never embedded directly in the PDF
- Pitch materials use accessible, audience-neutral language (avoid technical art-direction jargon)

title: Worldbuilding Principles
body:
## Principles
- "Look twice to notice" layered storytelling: true natures hidden beneath mundane surfaces
- Indigenous local architecture is the true skeleton; multicultural immigrant decoration is the skin
- Phosphor vine = cyan, extremely subtle (#7DA9B8 lightest tone only), never neon
- Cinnabar red = Arthur's seal work, matte / desaturated (#8C2E2E–#C8351F), amateur / imperfect
- Magic elements stay in a dormant / research-sample / collected-artifact state — never glowing, floating, or flowing
- The Aequorian symbol reads as secular, stable, reassuring — a well-run public institution, not a power structure

title: Document Pipeline (Technical)
body:
## Pipeline
- Python → HTML → wkhtmltopdf with Noto Sans CJK SC fonts (ReportLab failed for CJK)
- HTML screenshots: puppeteer-core + bundled Chromium; ImageMagick for tall-page stitching; pngquant for compression
- Engine: Unity 6 with URP; custom post-processing shaders for a Chinese gongbi (工笔画) filter

## Storage
- Design docs: /mnt/project/Nightmare_Design
- Generated deliverables: /mnt/user-data/outputs/

body: {"v":2,"blocks":[{"id":"b-mqykbrgd-6-dic8","type":"hero","props":{"eyebrow":"Narrative spine · from FigJam","title":"Hero’s Journey — Dreamscape","subtitle":"The consolidated story spine of the Dreamcatchers, mapped to the twelve-step monomyth. Everything here is lifted from the FigJam board.","tone":"accent"}},{"id":"b-mqykbrgd-7-1tj0","type":"badges","props":{"label":"At a glance","badgesJson":"[{\"label\":\"Twelve-step monomyth\",\"tone\":\"purple\"},{\"label\":\"Four-person crew\",\"tone\":\"sky\"},{\"label\":\"Nightmares & a portal\",\"tone\":\"red\"},{\"label\":\"Status: rough draft\",\"tone\":\"amber\"}]"}},{"id":"b-mqykbrgd-8-mz3y","type":"paragraph","text":"This page gathers the story elements that already exist on the “Hero’s Journey Dreamscape” FigJam board and arranges them as a single narrative. No beats, names, or motivations have been invented — gaps the board left open are marked as open questions, not filled in."},{"id":"b-mqykbrgd-9-pr61","type":"heading2","text":"Premise"},{"id":"b-mqykbrgd-a-70gw","type":"paragraph","text":"Four strangers — Aria, Harriet, @adrian and Shopin — each answer the same job posted online by “Beneath the Moon”: make real haunting footage of an abandoned hospital at the city corner. The city (New Miri) is under a church-enforced curfew because of strange “infections.” In the hospital the recruits meet, fall prey to that infection, and nearly all slip into a weird slumber — until an owl, Stiffy, flies in, saves them, and urges them to a mansion. There they meet Dr. Arthur, who recruits them as “Dreamcatchers” to investigate the nightmares in exchange for upgraded gear and pay. @aria "},{"id":"b-mqykbrgd-b-0n8a","type":"heading2","text":"The deep backstory"},{"id":"b-mqykbrgd-c-cyda","type":"paragraph","text":"Roughly 200 years ago, Archmengus — a biologist on the church’s expedition team — discovered a portal while searching for rare herbs. The church sealed it, but unfamiliar dreams began pouring through; fearing the city would lose faith in them, the church kept it secret. Archmengus kept experimenting, learning the dreams carry huge amounts of energy that doesn’t belong to this world, and captured one in a “star spark jar.”"},{"id":"b-mqykbrgd-d-ma9k","type":"paragraph","text":"His wife Rachel studied the seam with him. New Miri is a cursed city where some are born with a disease; Archmengus found the seam could stabilize that disease — which threatened the church’s whole narrative that the sickness is a punishment from the gods, cleansed only through them. Rather than lose authority, the church cured only some and left the rest; Rachel was not cured. The church moved to kill Archmengus and his wife (who carried his ascension notes): they killed the wife but failed to kill him. Archmengus opened the portal, and nightmares started coming in. He has since ascended / gone into the portal to search for his wife’s soul, believing it retrievable in the world the portal connects to. (The board notes Morpheus as “half-god, half what Archmengus left behind,” and floats Dr. Arthur — Arthur Crowe — as an “embodiment of vengeance” who recruits the four.)"},{"id":"b-mqykbrgd-e-diy9","type":"paragraph","text":"On the surface the phenomenon reads as a consequence of Archmengus’ ascent; underneath, he has been investigating it since it began, and learned that sending the dreams back has to be done “the eastern way.” The Dreamcatchers must study his notes to understand how to properly interact with dreams and send them back. Dr. Arthur’s booklet — which the team fills in as they go — works like the journal in Phasmophobia: nightmare types, tools, recorded after each encounter."},{"id":"b-mqykbrgd-f-y6lr","type":"heading2","text":"The crew"},{"id":"b-mqykbrgd-g-2utz","type":"cards","props":{"label":"Four answers to one job posting","columns":3,"cardsJson":"[{\"eyebrow\":\"The Listener\",\"title\":\"Aria\",\"body\":\"Ex-prodigy of the Veiled cult who watched a sacrifice and escaped. Can “listen” to ghosts and nightmares — a power from a nightmare she’s touched since childhood.\",\"tone\":\"purple\"},{\"eyebrow\":\"The Director\",\"title\":\"Harriet\",\"body\":\"Orphan who knew the under-city by heart as a thief, left her gang after a friend died in jail, then ran banned horror videos for Vibestream until she was kicked out.\",\"tone\":\"slate\"},{\"eyebrow\":\"The Light\",\"title\":\"Adrian\",\"body\":\"Starving film-school grad, exploited on set; left filmmaking to become a barista, then took the “Beneath the Moon” gaffer job.\",\"tone\":\"amber\"},{\"eyebrow\":\"The Determined\",\"title\":\"Shopin\",\"body\":\"Found his parents in an unbreakable slumber and fled with his mom’s Leica; took the hospital job near his home for clues to save them.\",\"tone\":\"sky\"}]"}},{"id":"b-mqykbrgd-h-pz9b","type":"paragraph","text":"Supporting cast on the board: Dr. Arthur (Arthur Crowe), the eccentric who recruits and upgrades them; Stiffy, the owl who rescues the crew and later provides their operating vehicle."},{"id":"b-mqykbrgd-i-s685","type":"heading2","text":"The two powers in conflict"},{"id":"b-mqykbrgd-j-38aq","type":"cards","props":{"label":"Factions","columns":2,"cardsJson":"[{\"eyebrow\":\"Faith & status quo\",\"title\":\"The Church\",\"body\":\"Wants to maintain the status quo of faith and stop the rumor that anyone can ascend. Its administrative arm is the police.\",\"tone\":\"red\"},{\"eyebrow\":\"The escaped prodigy’s cult\",\"title\":\"The Veiled\",\"body\":\"The cult Aria was a child prodigy of, where she witnessed a sacrifice before escaping.
